content.short: Neutral is a marketplace where allocators source quant strategies and traders raise capital.
content.description: Neutral is a marketplace where allocators source quant strategies and trading teams raise capital. Each vault is independently managed by a professional quant team with institutional custody behind it, and the vaults themselves are non-custodial smart contracts reporting real-time statistics. Strategies span trend-following, momentum and macro directional vaults, plus an NT Earn product for lower-risk passive yield, and the minimum is 100 dollars, so the same strategies are open to anyone with a wallet. Cumulative capital raised is shown on the platform.
content.meta: Connects allocators with quant traders, with the track record verifiable onchain.
